name: First Tide Ledger
locationContext: Written in the vestry of the Drowned Cathedral
context: The first recorded tide-ledger of the Sprawl.
bodyText: Day 1: the water rose past the third step. Day 2: the bells rang by themselves. Day 3: Mother Sael said the sea was listening.

name: Seawall Breach Report
context: Official report on the Level 3 breach.
bodyText: TIMESTAMP 04:12 — BREACH LEVEL 3 CONFIRMED. WARDEN ORDERS: DO NOT FILE. SERGEANT NOTE: THEY'RE LYING.

name: Hale's Eel Notes
bodyText: Light means bait. Always. Don't follow it. If it follows you, shut the lantern and sink.

name: Dr. Ruvo's Ward Log
bodyText: Day 41: antibiotics at two weeks. Day 42: Trident raised the filter price again. Day 43: I will not sleep.

name: Veyl's Hymn
context: A hum recorded at the Shrine.
bodyText: [A low hum. A voice: "Hush, hush. It is listening." The hum fades into static.]

name: Wren's Sensor Map
bodyText: NODE 7: 3 blind spots. NODE 9: Choir jamming. NOTE: they know.

name: Reyes' Ledger
bodyText: Shipment 12: medicine, 40 crates. Customer: Mercy Drop. Mark up: 300%. Guilt: unmarked.

name: The Listener Answers
bodyText: [Chanting. A new voice answers in the same cadence. The chanting stops.]
